name: Alyssa Morgan
headline: Building meaningful digital experiences through creative strategy.
intro: I’m a digital marketing specialist and content creator who turns ideas into brands people remember, from social storytelling to data-informed campaigns.
about_text: I studied marketing communication, but I fell in love with storytelling. Over the past few years I’ve helped small brands find their voice, grow their communities, and turn scrolling into connection.

I manage social platforms end to end, from strategy and content to reporting. I’m always curious about what’s next in digital trends, and I love solving creative problems where data and instinct meet.

experience.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
points: Lead multi-channel strategy across social, email and paid media.
Grew combined social reach by 60% in 12 months.
Cut cost per lead by 28% through creative testing.

experience.title: Social Media Executive
points: Managed 5 brand accounts and a monthly calendar of 40+ posts.
Raised average engagement rate from 2.1% to 4.8%.
Launched an influencer program with 25 micro-creators.

experience.title: Marketing Intern
points: Supported campaign research, copywriting and weekly reporting.
Produced 30+ content pieces for blog and social.
Helped grow the newsletter list by 18%.

projects.title: Verde Café: a voice worth following
projects.summary: Rebuilt voice, visuals and a 90-day content plan.
projects.challenge: A neighbourhood café with great coffee and no consistent look online.
projects.strategy: A warm brand voice, a photo style guide and a 90-day content calendar built around daily rituals.
projects.results: Followers up 72% and engagement 3.4× in one quarter.

projects.title: Luma Skincare: Reels-led growth
projects.challenge: Strong products, but reach had plateaued.
projects.strategy: Weekly Reels, honest routine videos and partnerships with 12 creators.
projects.results: Reach up 48% and 15K new followers in four months.

projects.title: Nomad Gear: trend-led short-form
projects.summary: A trend-led short-form series for outdoor gear.
projects.challenge: A new TikTok account with no audience.
projects.strategy: Three recurring formats that borrowed trending sounds while showing real product use.

projects.title: Atelier Home: ads that earn their spend
projects.summary: Meta and Google ads with creative testing.
projects.challenge: Rising acquisition costs on paid channels.
projects.strategy: Structured creative tests, tighter audiences and landing pages matched to each ad.
projects.results: Return on ad spend reached 3.8× while cost per acquisition fell 28%.
